motivation: The frozen mechanism-first pilot showed that M1 represented 6/7 actual mechanisms at the planning stage but achieved 0/7 final semantic alignment, with 6/7 plan-to-CodeQL translation losses. Both M0 and M1 also exhibited 7/7 generic-template collapse.
research_question: Given the exact same frozen mechanism-first plan, can an explicit semantic-preservation translation contract reduce plan-to-CodeQL translation loss and generic-template collapse compared with the original M1 translation, while retaining compilability?
experimental_unit: One CWE-level CodeQL query applied uniformly to all seven CWE-639 TRAIN vulnerable-patched pairs.

treatment_translation.name: T1_SEMANTIC_PRESERVATION_TRANSLATION
intervention: Before writing CodeQL, convert every mechanism family already present in the frozen M1 plan into an explicit mechanism contract.
Each mechanism contract must identify security subject/context, attacker-controlled input or trigger, protected object/state, decisive authorization/validation/relation, and sensitive effect.
Create an explicit traceability mapping from every mechanism contract to at least one CodeQL predicate or query branch.
Do not replace heterogeneous mechanism contracts with a single generic user-controlled ID/key -> sensitive operation abstraction.
A multi-branch CWE-level query is allowed and preferred when different mechanism families require different security predicates.
If CodeQL cannot faithfully encode a planned mechanism, the translation must preserve that limitation explicitly rather than silently replacing it with a generic IDOR heuristic.

secondary_outcomes.repair_convergence: number of repairs to full compilation or MAX_REPAIRS

diagnostic_case_policy.rule: Hit-based strict success must remain separate from semantic correctness. Do not assign semantic alignment from hit results.

success_interpretation.support_for_translation_intervention: T1 shows higher semantic alignment and/or lower translation-loss and generic-template counts than frozen T0 under the same plan.
success_interpretation.no_support: T1 does not improve those semantic outcomes despite the explicit preservation contract.

claim_scope: Any result is limited to this CWE-639 TRAIN translation pilot. No claim to other CWEs or TEST is permitted without replication.
